candidates.description: This vector activates for terms related to education, academic achievement, and graduation.

This vector activates for words and subwords related to oversight, management, monitoring, and administrative control.
This vector represents two-letter abbreviations commonly used as postal codes for US states and Canadian provinces.
This vector represents common Portuguese grammatical and function words, such as pronouns, prepositions, and auxiliary verbs.
This feature activates on honorifics, titles, and forms of address used before personal names.
This feature vector activates on subwords, suffixes, and character combinations related to Romance languages, particularly Portuguese and French vocabulary.
This vector activates tokens associated with formal organizations, institutions, and societies.
